note: End-to-end worked case: BIS Entity List designation of SMIC joined to the supply chain layer by a reified LEI identifier. Every fact carries its public source in basis; nothing is from memory.

lei_record.basis: GLEIF API lei-records/300300522KCU7YI25841, retrieved 2026-08-03. legalName is the Chinese-language registration; the English name is an ALTERNATIVE_LANGUAGE_LEGAL_NAME. registration.status LAPSED (last update 2022-03-01).

identity_links.why: CSL Entity List record of SMIC (regulatory domain node)
curated supply chain record of SMIC (economic domain node)

authority.label: Bureau of Industry and Security, U.S. Department of Commerce

export_control.label: Addition of SMIC to the BIS Entity List (85 FR 83416)
export_control.controlScope: licence requirement for items subject to the EAR; presumption of denial for items uniquely required for production at technology nodes of 10 nanometers or below
export_control.basis: Federal Register 85 FR 83416 (published 2020-12-22, effective 2020-12-18), 'Addition of Entities to the Entity List...', document 2020-28031. HS 848620 stands for the machine layer named in the presumption-of-denial scope (semiconductor manufacturing machines); the designation itself is entity-directed.

supply_edge.label: ASML supplies DUV lithography systems to SMIC (volume purchase agreement)
supply_edge.basis: ASML press release 'Clarification on SMIC volume purchasing agreement' (March 2021): volume purchase agreement for DUV lithography entered 2018-01-01, extended 2021-02-01 to run through December 2021; purchase orders of USD 1.2 billion in aggregate over 2020-03-16 to 2021-03-02. EUV systems are not covered; the press release concerns DUV only.

affects_edge.basis: Rule stated on bridge:affects: a sanctioned entity at an endpoint of a supply relation marks that relation at risk. The listed organisation is the customer endpoint; the designation subjects exports to SMIC to licence requirements (85 FR 83416).
